items.title: 7TH EDITION OF THE MARSHAL OF THE AIR FORCE ARJAN SINGH MEMORIAL HOCKEY TOURNAMENT-2026 OPENING CEREMONY ON 23 Jun 26
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Defence 7TH EDITION OF THE MARSHAL OF THE AIR FORCE ARJAN SINGH MEMORIAL HOCKEY TOURNAMENT-2026 OPENING CEREMONY ON 23 Jun 26 प्रविष्टि तिथि: 23 JUN 2026 2:44PM by PIB Delhi As a part of 107th Birth Anniversary of the Marshal of the Air Force Arjan Singh DFC, 7th edition of Marshal of the Air Force Arjan Singh Memorial Hockey Tournament-2026 is being organised…
